notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm writing a short post to let you know that I've uploaded a new build of Fragile Feelings! This build fixes a handful of typos which were pointed out by the kind people on the Steam community forum and over on my Discord channel. Now, your Fragile Feelings experience should be even more polished!

As always, please let me know if you find further typos (or any bugs) in this most recent build, and I'll try to upload a fix when I'm able.

Thank you very much for your help!

- ebi x
